decision_rule.timestamp_basis: package hourly timestamp day for hourly aggregation; daily product date for daily cross-check

event.name: Super Typhoon Yagi severe wind and rainfall impacts
event.region: South China Sea, Hainan, southern China, and northern Viet Nam

primary_gt.computed_sentence: The 7 September peak gust and rainfall maximum satisfy the same-day, 2-hour lag, 60% rainfall-share, and daily cross-check tests.

criteria.name: Final peak-window label
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2 points for the correct date with an imprecise label; award 1 point for noting strong wind and rain without applying the rule.

criteria.description: Reports the 116.6 km/h peak gust at 2024-09-07T12:00 and 17.8 mm peak hourly rain at 2024-09-07T13:00.
criteria.name: Hourly peak extraction
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for one exact peak plus the correct date; award 1 point for approximate peak values without times.

criteria.description: Computes 165.3 mm event rainfall, 119.0 mm wettest-day rainfall, and wettest-day share 0.72 or 72.0%.
criteria.name: Rainfall aggregation and share
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for correct accumulation values with a missing or slightly rounded share; award 1 point for only naming the wettest day.

criteria.description: Computes a +1.0 hour gust-to-rain lag and marks same_day, lag_le_2h, and share_ge_0_60 as true.
criteria.name: Lag and rule flags
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for correct flags with a missing signed lag or minor threshold wording error.

criteria.description: Uses the daily precipitation maximum of 118.6 mm/day and daily 10 m wind maximum of 11.81 m/s, both on 2024-09-07.
criteria.name: Daily cross-check
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for recognizing daily agreement but omitting one value.

criteria.description: Provides concise JSON with the requested fields and avoids unrequested casualty, housing, mapped-damage, or broad narrative additions.
criteria.name: Structured answer discipline
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for correct computations with minor JSON or verbosity problems.
